title: Chapter 107 Human Wanderers Join
content:
Chapter 107 Human Wanderers Join

"Let's go back to the city! Those guys from the Tengu tribe will definitely not be able to bring themselves to see us! Hahaha!"

Seeing that the Tengu tribe had withdrawn directly, Meng was very happy.

The lords of the alliance were more proud than ever before. They felt that the mountain that had been weighing on their hearts had suddenly disappeared, and now they were extremely relaxed.

Everyone returned to Mengzhong City happily. Wu Qing sent out the Zerg troops to explore the empty military camp outside Mengzhong City. After confirming that it was safe, a small number of Zerg were left to garrison.

The lords of the alliance were going to spend the night here today. They were going to take this rare opportunity to raise all the issues that needed to be discussed in the alliance, and everyone would work overtime overnight to solve them.

The lords, whose mentality had changed greatly, were going to go back and do a big job tomorrow.

The lords, who had just eaten and drunk enough and were in a good mood, sat together again. The first thing they discussed was the distribution of spoils.

Each territory was in urgent need of development, so of course the spoils had to be divided first.

On the contrary, the development of the alliance city is not urgent for the time being, as long as the city can be defended.

The distribution of the spoils this time was very smooth, there was no intrigue, and even mutual humility.

Everyone's spirit is high, and their eyes are not only focused on the small profits in front of them, but also look at the problem from a higher level.

The development of the alliance brings real benefits. Everyone is the founder of the alliance, and they all hope that the development of the alliance will get better and better, and then completely change everyone's destiny.

Various topics were put forward one by one, and everyone expressed their opinions, offered suggestions, quickly reached a consensus, and solved the problem efficiently.

After a night of fighting, everyone was in high spirits. Many problems of the alliance were solved in this night, and the various systems and regulations of the alliance were also improved and refined during this opportunity.

This will lay a solid foundation for the rapid development of the alliance.

...

The next morning, the lords who had worked hard all night had a hearty breakfast together and were about to return to the territory.

Wu Qing's clone is also preparing to return to Daxia Territory. Mengzhong City only needs to keep Zerg troops for garrison. The construction of the city is not yet ripe, so it is temporarily shelved.

Wu Qing plans to keep only 10,000 Zerg troops in Mengzhong City. With the Zerg's lurking ability, outsiders generally cannot figure out the specific number of Zerg.

There is actually not much difference in deterrence between a Zerg garrison of 10,000 and a Zerg garrison of 100,000. If there is a real war, 10,000 Zerg troops will defend the city, and the Zerg army in the Zerg territory will soon be able to rush to support through the built avenue.

It is not painful to destroy Mengzhong City. Anyway, it will be expanded in the future. As long as the lord's scepter is not lost, it will be fine.

The other Zerg troops in Mengzhong City will quietly withdraw to the Zerg territory. The end of the war here does not mean that the Zerg will cease fire.

The huge lord guards escorted the lords of the alliance back to the territory. The five thousand alliance elites from the five territories also returned with their respective lords. In the alliance, except for the Zerg, they participated in the war, which is a very proud thing.

These alliance elites who have experienced this war will become an important part of the alliance army in the future and play their role.

Wu Qing also took ten Zerg guards and a team of Zerg troops and followed this team back to Daxia Territory. In Daxia Territory, there are still many things that he needs to deal with personally.

After saying goodbye one by one, only Wu Qing needs to continue on his way. Daxia Territory is at the real foot of the Endless Mountains and is the most remote place.

...

In Daxia Territory, two thousand human wanderers rested and recovered here.

Daxia Territory did not restrict their freedom. They could walk around and chat with others.

Through the understanding of these few days, they have a preliminary understanding of Daxia Territory and Zerg.

With the sufficient food supply in Daxia Territory, they recovered quickly. After changing clothes and cleaning, their appearance was completely different from when they first met.

When Wu Qing's clone came to Daxia Territory, he saw a group of sturdy human beings. Each of them was very imposing and had their own characteristics.

This was a group of elite and organized human beings.

"Meet the Lord!"

They had received the news that Wu Qing was coming. When Wu Qing came, they recognized him and quickly lined up to greet him.

Under the leadership of the masked leader named Wu Cong, two thousand human wanderers respectfully saluted Wu Qing.

"No need to salute!"

"Because of the busy affairs, I have never had time to come and meet all my fellow tribesmen in person!"

"Today, I see that you are all heroes of our tribe!"

"My Daxia Territory is just built, and the conditions are too simple, which makes everyone suffer!"

"..."

Wu Qing smiled and said a few polite words to the two thousand neatly lined human wanderers.

"Lord, you are too polite!"

"Lord, you saved my life, but we have not yet repaid you, how can we talk about happiness and sorrow!"

"On behalf of the two thousand wanderers, I express my sincere gratitude to the Lord!"

Wu Cong expressed his gratitude to Wu Qing on behalf of the two thousand wanderers.

The two exchanged some politeness, and Wu Qing invited Wu Cong to the temporary station. The two had some things to talk about.

...

"Leader Wu Cong, you should have heard that the Zerg is a race that has only been in the world for a few days. I have also been living in the Zerg. When I came out, I was in this remote place, and the source of information is very limited."

"To be honest, when I first heard about you, I had never heard of human wanderers. I only found out about them after asking other lords."

"Chief Wu Cong is well-informed. I have many common-sense questions that I need to ask you about. I hope you will give me your advice!"

Wu Qing learned from Meng that human wanderers were wandering around, and they were all well-informed and experienced people. He wanted to get more information from Wu Cong, especially information about the human race.

Although Meng also has rich experience, he is from the Tiger clan and has been in this place for many years. There are some things that he may not know clearly.

"Obligated!"

Wu Cong readily agreed.

Next, the two of them chatted about some topics as if they were having a family affair, and Wu Qing also gained a better understanding of the outside world.

"Leader Wu Cong, what are your plans next?"

Seeing that the atmosphere was almost calm, Wu Qing got to the point.

"We are going to stay in Daxia Territory! To repay the lord for saving our lives!"

"I hope the lord will take you in!"

Wu Cong didn't mince words and made his decision directly.

"There are people from all races in my Daxia territory, but there are only a handful of humans from the same race. If everyone is willing to stay, of course I can't help but ask for it!"

Wu Qing was also very happy when he received the reply from Wu Cong that he had officially decided to stay.
